title: Absurd amount of advertisment pop-ups
body:
I get that you need ads in-order to make some revenue. But an app that by which entire purpose is to give you dopamin rewards, the ad popp-ups are way wayy too frequent. Whenever you click/check-off a task to eventually build up said habit, intsead here you will get a forced ad popping up - replacing “the feel-good” with this uncanny worry that perhaps you’ll have some ad showing up. Removing the entire joy of checking of tasks or any other things you do makes the purpose of this app obsolete.

Great design destroyed by insane amount of ads.
author: Mr. Deh
